findings.summary: A retry can reject legitimate target edits because changed_files is a path-set post-minus-pre delta, while nonzero-exit and lane-violation retry branches leave the target dirty. On the next successful attempt the target appears in both snapshots, so _target_was_modified returns false and the verifier is skipped.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the task target before every retry-producing branch (without touching sibling targets), or use content-aware target snapshots; add a retry regression test covering a dirty target from the prior attempt.
